scope: Interim completed-case snapshot; no fitting, no writes to CFD inputs or running case outputs.
findings: Halving the time step from 2 to 1 ms changes the total iodine deposit profile by 0.0043–0.323% across the four numerical cases. This is a two-step comparison, not a temporal extrapolation.
Refining 18,432 to 41,472 cells changes the iodine deposit profile by 2.06–10.58%. The complete distribution is not established as mesh independent.
Largest completed iodine-profile changes from the original case: kinetics: 4.21%; source_geometry: 0.17%; transport: 14.20%. These are scenario effects, not measured parameter uncertainties.

The 1 cm scan bins can change which bin is identified as the peak. For pure PbI2, the original 36 and 37 cm bins differ in height by only 0.05%; the fine mesh selects 36 cm, changing the reported peak temperature from about 351 to 366 °C. Use full profiles alongside peak temperatures.

The large chemistry sensitivity survives refinement: at 1% source saturation, fine-mesh BiI3 carries 94.57% of deposited iodide iodine with baseline thermodynamics versus 2.00% with the BiI +29 kJ/mol surrogate. This surrogate is not an independently measured thermodynamic dataset.
Grid estimates are conditional scalar estimates. Oscillatory and non-decreasing sequences receive no extrapolation; stable total deposition does not establish profile convergence.
Results still pending in this snapshot: flow_reference: 4, kinetics: 2, shutdown: 4, silica_alignment: 4, source_geometry: 2, source_loading: 12, transport: 3.
